title: Debit Card Service Needs Improvement
body:
Most of the services provided by Emirates NBD are very good, and I am satisfied with the overall banking experience.

However, I faced an issue with my new debit card delivery. The card was not delivered and was returned to the bank. Unfortunately, the app does not provide any option to raise a complaint about this issue.

When I try to apply for a new card through the “Block and Replace Debit Card” option, it says, “You are not eligible for this service.”

There is also no proper live chat or messaging option available to resolve this issue.

If Emirates NBD improves its customer support options within the app and provides an easy way to report delivery issues and request a replacement card, the overall banking experience would be much better.

I hope the bank takes this feedback seriously and improves this service.

title: Critical Feedback: Automated Customer Service & AI Virtual Assistant Experience.
body:
Quality is what guides any business to success, but Emirates NBD urgently needs to step into its clients' shoes and test its own services. 

As a customer, I am facing constant friction with the automated support system. The AI virtual assistant works for standard, pre-trained queries, but for anything slightly custom, it gets lost and repeats itself indefinitely. When you explicitly ask to speak to a human representative, it stubbornly insists it can handle the issue. 

The experience on WhatsApp is equally unreliable. To make matters worse, after finally persuading the voice assistant over the phone to transfer the call, the system routes straight to the agent evaluation feedback survey before a human agent ever speaks to you. 

Technology should streamline client support, not make simple problem-solving nearly impossible.

title: Poor service and inefficient processes
body:
I requested the cancellation of a credit card that had never been activated. Despite the simplicity of this request, the process remained unresolved for an entire week. I contacted customer service daily, yet each interaction resulted in the same response, with no meaningful updates, clear explanation, or indication of progress.

The handling of a subsequent callback was particularly disappointing. I had difficulty understanding the representative and politely requested assistance from an Arabic-speaking agent. Instead of accommodating my request or arranging a suitable alternative, the representative disconnected the call without explanation. I did not receive a follow-up call. This raises serious concerns regarding communication standards, professionalism, and the bank’s commitment to customer support.

Furthermore, the information provided on the bank’s website regarding instant approval for car loans does not appear to reflect the actual customer experience. In practice, even straightforward procedures can take several working days, creating unnecessary delays and inconvenience. This discrepancy between advertised service expectations and the actual process warrants clarification.

My experience with email support has been equally unsatisfactory. Responses have taken approximately a week, and after prolonged waiting, I was simply directed to the bank’s official website without receiving a practical solution to my enquiry. Such a response does little to resolve customer concerns and undermines the purpose of having a dedicated customer support channel.

title: Fraud from ENBD
body:
Dear Fraud Investigation Team,
I am writing to formally and strictly dispute an unauthorized fraudulent transaction of AED 3153.80 charged to my credit card, which has driven my account balance into a negative of -3153.80AED.
What makes this situation alarming and entirely unacceptable is that this credit card has never been activated or used by me for a single transaction in my life. It has remained locked/unused in my possession since it was issued.
Furthermore:
No OTP Was Generated or Received: At no point did I receive any One-Time Password (OTP), verification code, or transaction alert on my registered mobile number for this transaction. The absence of an OTP strongly indicates a severe security vulnerability, system bypass, or unauthorized breach on the bank's transaction processing side.
Lack of Bank Transparency: Despite filing an initial complaint, I have received zero follow-up, no explanation as to how my card data was compromised while entirely unused, and automated collection messages demanding payment for fraud I did not commit.
My Demands:
Immediate Account Reversal: Reverse the disputed charge of 3153.80 immediately and clear the negative balance on my account.
Full Investigation Report: Provide a written root-cause analysis explaining how a transaction was successfully processed on a card that has never been used, and why no multi-factor authentication (OTP) was triggered or sent to my phone.
Cease Collection Actions: Suspend all automated collection notices, text messages, or negative credit reporting regarding this disputed amount while the investigation is ongoing.
Please consider this a formal escalation. If this matter is not investigated and resolved promptly, I will be forced to escalate this complaint to the Central Bank of the UAE (Consumer Protection Department) and relevant regulatory authorities.
I expect a written response and a call from a senior fraud investigator within 48 hours.
Sincerely,
Haitham

title: Not straightforward credit card settlement
body: Its not making it easy to close all my credit card outstanding amount!
author: MSSkh12

reply.body: Hello, thank you for reaching out to us. To make the payment for your outstanding amount as per statement, click on "Cards" section, tap on the credit card you wish to pay - scroll down to Statement - tap on "PAY NOW". Then you will be given the option to pay either your "Minimum payment due (which is the 1st option), the "balance to be paid to avoid charges (which is the 2nd option and will cover the full outstanding amount you have utilized your card for that particular period), and "Other amount (which is the 3rd option where you can pay any amount you want to). For example, if your card has an outstanding amount of AED 5,000 as per the statement generated, but your total outstanding amount or usage on the card is already at AED 7,000, then you can opt to choose option 3 where you will enter the amount manually and will bring down your outstanding amount to zero (0). Should you need further assistance on how to navigate through the App, you may reach us at +971600540000 which is open 24/7, or via email at at mobilebankingdev@emiratesnbd.com with details of your concerns to assist you better.

title: Missing Funds
body: I am writing regarding a fund transfer I made on 2 October at 4:41 PM. I transferred funds from my Emirates NBD account to my personal FAB account. Normally, the funds are credited within a few minutes, but several hours passed without the amount being received. As it was already evening, I waited until the following day to check again, but the funds were still not credited. I contacted Emirates NBD and was advised that a system glitch had delayed the transaction. I have called multiple times with ENBD to see the status but no luck! Since it was the weekend, I waited until Monday, but the amount was still not credited. Emirates NBD then informed me that the transfer had been completed on their side and advised me to check with FAB. But FAB has repeatedly advised me to follow up with Emirates NBD and obtain a SWIFT copy of the transaction. Emirates NBD cannot provide one because this was a local transfer, and SWIFT documentation applies to international transfers. This is a serious matter. The amount remains unaccounted for, and I need urgent assistance in locating the funds. Please investigate the transaction immediately and confirm the status and location of my money. This situation is unacceptable, particularly as I was informed that the delay resulted from a system glitch.

Secondly, why is there no easy way on the app to report fraud? I had this issue the other day and in a panic was completely unable to report a transaction as fraudulent on the app, I had to call a call centre. Surely as a banking app that is one of your main functions / services?

title: Bad customer service
body:
Dear Emirates NBD Customer Support,

I am writing to formally express my frustration and request your urgent assistance regarding my account.

My account was converted to a non-resident account; however, it has been placed under restrictions that prevent me from accessing or using my own funds. I currently have AED 1,000 available in my account, but I am unable to use this money to make payments, including my Emirates NBD credit card payment.

Previously, I contacted your support team and was advised to submit a request to update my profile. I was informed that this process would take up to eight (8) working days. Unfortunately, that timeframe has already passed, and I have not received any update or response regarding the status of my request.

In addition, one of your customer service representatives informed me that the outstanding amount on my credit card would be deducted from my debit account. However, this has not happened. The AED 1,000 remains in my account, my credit card balance continues to increase due to unpaid amounts, and I am becoming increasingly concerned about additional interest and charges that are accumulating because I am unable to access my own funds.

This situation is causing me significant inconvenience and financial stress. I respectfully request that you:

* Provide an immediate update on the status of my profile update request.
* Remove the unnecessary restrictions on my account, or advise me of the exact steps required to restore full access.
* Process the payment from my available account balance to my credit card as previously advised, or provide an immediate alternative solution.
* Confirm what measures will be taken regarding any interest or late charges that have accumulated as a result of this unresolved issue.

I would appreciate your urgent attention to this matter and a prompt resolution. Please treat this as a priority, as I have made several attempts to resolve this issue without success.

I look forward to your immediate response.

Kind regards,

Julanie Primero

title: about call
body:
Honestly, everything about HNBD is good except their customer service by phone. Every time I call, I have to wait 10–15 minutes, and most of the time nobody answers the call.

What makes it even more frustrating is that the call is not free, so I end up losing a lot of my mobile balance just waiting. This has happened to me several times before. I have waited for around 10 minutes, only for the call to be disconnected without anyone answering, and then I have to call again and wait another 10–15 minutes.

Today, the exact same thing happened again. I waited for around 8 minutes, my mobile balance was completely deducted, and still nobody answered my call.

HNBD has many good services, but this phone customer service experience is extremely disappointing. Customers should not have to spend their own money and waste so much time just trying to speak to someone. Please improve your call centre service and make sure customers can actually reach a representative.

body:
I would like to share some feedback regarding the latest ENBD app update. Previously, when I had an outstanding amount and selected Pay Now, the amount due was clearly displayed on the payment page, which made the process quick and convenient.

With the new update, the outstanding amount is no longer visible on the Pay Now page. I now have to go back to the previous page to check the amount, remember it, and then return to Pay Now to complete the payment.

title: Hidden fees and zero support for app complaints
body: Highly disappointed with the ENBD X app and the bank's dispute handling. An agent explicitly promised me a 0% interest EMI offer, and even though the payment was strictly in AED, I was hit with hidden international processing fees. Customer support told me to use the app to resolve the issue, but the app gives zero transparency or real updates on ongoing disputes. They refuse to review their own customer care call logs to verify what was promised. Other banks like ADCB and Mashreq manage their digital disputes, tracking, and customer service much more reliably. If you want transparent card management and functional app support, look elsewhere.

title: Wealth account is a disaster
body:
The Wealth Account in ENBD X has caused me financial losses of more than AED 20,000. The trading system is unreliable. When I place buy or sell orders, my funds get locked, and I am unable to modify or cancel my orders while the market is moving. I have had to watch my portfolio lose money without being able to take any action.

Customer support is extremely slow. By the time they respond to complaints, the market has already moved and the financial damage is done. A trading platform should never prevent customers from managing their own orders in real time.

This has been a terrible experience, and I have completely lost confidence in the ENBD X Wealth platform. I hope the bank urgently fixes these issues before more customers suffer financial losses.

title: Outstanding Banking App – Fast, Secure & Truly Next‑Level!
body:
I’ve been using the Emirates NBD ENBD X mobile banking app for a while, and it is honestly one of the best banking apps in the UAE. The app is beautifully designed, extremely fast, and very easy to navigate. Managing my accounts, cards, and transactions feels effortless.

I love how the app offers 150+ instant banking services, from card controls to statements, bill payments, and even investment options—all in one place. The DirectRemit transfers are lightning fast, and the app’s security features give complete peace of mind.

The global dashboard showing a 360° view of all my finances is a game‑changer. Even updating Emirates ID, opening deposits, or checking offers happens instantly without visiting the branch.

Overall, ENBD X sets a new standard for mobile banking. Smooth performance, powerful features, and excellent reliability. Truly a 5‑star experience!

⭐ Highly recommended! ⭐

title: Stop Advertising If You Won’t Accept Customers
body:
I receive countless NBD Bank advertisements every day, but when I finally decided to open an account, I was instantly rejected with a generic message and no explanation.

This makes your advertising look misleading and pointless. If you don’t want customers, stop flooding people with ads. I already have accounts with major banks, so the issue is clearly not basic eligibility.

Instead of spending so much on marketing, NBD Bank should focus on fixing its onboarding process and providing transparent reasons for rejection. In today’s banking world, customers expect honesty and efficiency—not endless ads followed by unexplained denials.

title: Poorest Customer Service Received
body:
I called today to ask for assistance regarding the deferment that was previously promised to me specifically that I would not be charged on May 27 as part of the program intended to help ease the situation of individuals experiencing financial difficulty.
I spoke with Agent Angelo this morning, and unfortunately, I had a very disappointing experience. There was absolutely no empathy or proper customer service attitude shown during the conversation. He repeatedly told me that the service request was not processed and that there was “nothing he could do” from his end. He also asked me if I had a service request number — but how would I know if this was never properly communicated to me in the first place?
First of all, it is not the customer’s fault if the request was not properly raised or processed internally. Instead of immediately responding with “unfortunately” and “no,” he could have at least shown willingness to help by offering to raise an escalation or provide a possible remedy, even if approval was not guaranteed.
What disappointed me the most was the lack of professionalism, empathy, and proper customer handling. I previously spoke with another ENBD agent whose name I unfortunately forgot, and he was excellent very patient, helpful, and guided me properly, even assisting me with cardless withdrawal instructions. That experience was completely different from what I experienced with Agent Angelo today.
Angelo, there is no need to speak to customers as if you are above them. Customers who are already dealing with financial difficulties deserve understanding and respect. At the very least, show empathy and professionalism.
As a customer who has already paid a significant amount toward my loan, with only around AED 10,000 remaining, this experience is extremely disappointing. Once I finish my loan, I honestly plan to close my account and will no longer recommend ENBD due to this poor customer service experience.
author: Irine Hinayon

reply.body: Hello Irine, please accept our sincere apologies for your negative experience. We strive to maintain the highest standards of service for our customers. Our contact center has arranged a callback to review your concerns, and a representative will contact you soon.

title: Extremely disappointing experience with Emirates NBD.
body:
Extremely disappointing experience with Emirates NBD. The bank charges a “cash advance fee” when using a credit card for crypto-related transactions, but there is absolutely no proper warning or clear notification shown before the transaction is completed. The amount gets deducted silently, and customers only find out later after checking the statement.

When contacted, customer service simply says “it is mentioned in the terms and conditions” — hidden inside a massive 100+ page PDF that most customers will never realistically read fully. Important charges like this should be clearly displayed upfront before approving the transaction, not buried deep in documents.

On top of that, the bank has removed proper chat support and forces customers into an AI system and phone calls. Reaching a real customer care agent quickly is extremely frustrating. The AI support is one of the worst experiences I have had in a banking app.

The service feels unfair, non-transparent, and customer unfriendly. Charging hidden-style fees like this feels like pure exploitation. A major bank should prioritize transparency and proper customer support instead of trapping customers with unclear charges and poor service.
author: Saleel Said Mohamed

reply.body: Dear Saleel, we sincerely apologize for the frustration regarding the cash advance fees and your experience with our support channels. We understand that transparency is vital, and we appreciate your detailed feedback on how these charges are displayed. Please be informed that a callback has been arranged with a specialized officer to discuss your concerns and clarify the terms regarding crypto-related transactions. We value your feedback as it helps us improve our support services.

title: Credit card
body: Got a very worst experience with credit card, nbd charged me interest even after clearing my dues with 24 hours of the time. And the interest amount was never mentioned in my payment. Nbd generated a new statement and mentioned  the interest amount. Which is very surprising and understandable considering the dues paid.
author: Rohaan J

reply.body: Hi Rohaan, Finance charges on credit cards are calculated on an average daily balance basis. If there was an outstanding balance carried over from the previous statement, interest continues to accrue on that amount from the date of the statement up until the date the bank receives your payment. Interest gets generated between the last statement date and your payment date; this is added to the following statement. This is often referred to as residual interest. To better understand the issue, request you to please WhatsApp us at +971600540000 or write to us at mobilebankingdev@emiratesnbd.com from your registered email address and our team will respond to you immediately. title: Very disappointed with Emirates NBD
body:
I was in a hurry and needed to pay my bills urgently to avoid fines. I deposited cash into an ATM to my own account, but the amount was not reflected in my account.

I immediately visited the branch at Mall of the Emirates, where they told me my account had been refreshed and that the money would be credited within one hour. I also called the hotline and was told the exact same thing.

Now it has been 6–7 hours, and I still haven’t received my money.

Because of this delay, I couldn’t pay my bill on time and now I have been charged a fine of 7,000 AED. This situation happened entirely because of the bank’s failure, despite all the promises and claims of being “the best bank.”

Once I get my money back, I will close my account and switch to another bank. This level of service is unacceptable, especially in urgent situations.

title: Unaddressed fraudulent transaction and poor customer service.
body:
In July, an unauthorized and fraudulent transaction amounting to over AED 8,000 was made on my credit card. I reported this immediately and was informed by your team that the investigation would take until October. However, in August, the case was closed **not in our favor**, without any prior notification, email update, or phone call.

When we followed up with the bank, we were informed that a police complaint was required along with a “reliability letter” supposedly sent by the bank. We never received this letter. Despite multiple follow-ups, we were repeatedly asked to wait 48 hours, only to receive no update. This cycle has continued multiple times without any resolution or clear guidance.

Due to repeated calls and follow-ups, we have incurred an additional loss of approximately AED 500 in communication costs alone. This is unacceptable, especially considering that:

* We did **not** share any OTP
* No biometric or cardholder authentication was done
* The transaction was clearly unauthorized
* The credit card bill has already been paid while the dispute remains unresolved

It is extremely concerning that a fraud transaction of this magnitude has not been properly investigated or communicated. The lack of responsibility, transparency, and guidance from the bank has caused financial loss, stress, and inconvenience.
